dev.title: Gifteez needs a Firebase config before cloud ideas can run.
dev.body: Copy .env.example to .env, fill in the Firebase values, then rebuild the native app. Restarting Metro is not enough, because the env file is read at build time.
dev.safe: The app is running. Nothing was sent to a server.

startup.title: Gifteez could not start
startup.config: Firebase is not configured on this phone. Fill in .env and rebuild the native app.
startup.network: The phone could not reach Firebase. Check the connection and try again.
startup.auth: Anonymous sign-in is off, so cloud ideas cannot start. The list on this phone still works.

recovery.title: We couldn't open your saved data
recovery.body: The copy on this phone is still here. Nothing was replaced.

firstOpen.title: Who are you shopping for?
firstOpen.lead: Type their name. Gift ideas are on the next screen.
firstOpen.sentence: Gifteez helps you remember gifts for the people you love, and keep the spending fair.
firstOpen.discardBody: The name and details you typed will not be saved.

people.addBirthday: Add {name}'s birthday so we can remind you
people.addFirst: Add the first person you shop for
people.nothingComing: Nothing coming up. Add an occasion
people.remindersOn: Reminders are on for this phone.
people.banner: You have used Gifteez for a while. Saving an email keeps your list if this phone is replaced.

person.noOccasionMatch: No occasion by that name. Add your own below.

person.deleteConfirmBody: Their occasions, ideas and gift history are deleted too.
person.deleteGiftBody: You can undo it for a few seconds.
person.readOnly: This person is read-only until the list is unlocked or someone is removed. Nothing was deleted.
person.hiddenRecipient: You are this person on the list, so gifts, claims, and ideas stay hidden.
person.linkHint: The member you pick can still see the name and the date. They cannot read gifts, claims, or ideas.
person.openedImported: Opening this person turns ideas on. Imported people stay quiet until then.

purchase.title: Log a purchase
purchase.claimedWarning: {name} already said they would get this. You can still log a purchase.

merge.title: Same person
merge.pick: Pick the person on another list.
merge.empty: You don't have this person on another list.
merge.gifts: Gifts to share with the group
merge.giftHint: Uncheck a gift to keep it private. Only you will see it on this person.
merge.privateNote: Unchecked gifts stay on a private record only you can read.
merge.done: Merged. The other copy was removed.
merge.confirmBody: This copies the checked gifts onto this person and removes the other copy after it saves. You can undo it from the person.

relationship.label: Relationship (optional)
relationship.invalid: Use letters, spaces, apostrophes, or hyphens.

fairness.title: Fairness
fairness.intro: People are compared only inside a circle.
fairness.emptyCircle: No one is in this circle.
fairness.homePrompt: Keep siblings even? Set up a circle
fairness.nameInvalid: Use letters, numbers, spaces, apostrophes, or hyphens.
fairness.deleteCircleBody: People in it stay on your list. They just won't be compared in this circle.
fairness.noneYet: No gifts logged yet, so there is nothing to compare.

shop.disclosure: As an Amazon Associate, Gifteez earns from qualifying purchases.

settings.title: Settings
settings.backupHint: Your list lives on this phone. Export a copy before you replace it.
settings.restoreBody: This replaces the people, occasions, ideas, gifts, and purchases on this phone.
settings.restoreConfirmLabel: Replace this phone's list with the backup
settings.restoreInvalid: That backup could not be read. Export a new one from Gifteez and try again.
settings.storeMissing: The store has no product for this build yet. The rest of the app still works.
settings.storeUnreachable: Couldn't reach the App Store. Try again.
settings.pasteHint: CSV or JSON from Santa's Bag, Christmas Gift List Tracker, or a spreadsheet with a name column.
settings.optional: These are optional. Gifteez never imports anyone on its own.
settings.remindersHint: Turning reminders on asks your phone for notification permission, so a date can nudge you.
settings.calendarHint: This asks to read birthdays from your calendar. Nothing is added until you pick people.
settings.contactsHint: This asks to read contacts so you can pick people. Nothing is added until you choose.
settings.remindersLabel: Turn occasion reminders on or off
settings.keepEveryoneBody: Free holds {count} people. Unlock once for unlimited people. No subscription.
settings.noPurchaseApple: No previous purchase found for this Apple ID.
settings.noPurchaseGoogle: No previous purchase found for this Google account.

importFlow.added: Added {count}. They stay quiet until you open them.

sync.offlineBanner: Offline. Changes stay on this phone until the connection is back.
